action_instruction: Checking whether the cart total equals the remaining line-item subtotals
intent: whether the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed remaining line-item subtotals

action_params.condition: the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed remaining line-item subtotals
action_params.query: whether the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed remaining line-item subtotals
action_params.code_js: (() => { const parse = s => parseFloat((s || '').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) || 0; const totalEl = el(7).querySelector('.cart-total'); const subtotalEls = Array.from(el(7).querySelectorAll('.cart-line-subtotal')); if (!totalEl || subtotalEls.length === 0) return null; const total = parse(totalEl.textContent); const subtotalSum = subtotalEls.reduce((sum, node) => sum + parse(node.textContent), 0); return Math.abs(total - subtotalSum) < 0.005; })()

assertion_tree.description: the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed remaining line-item subtotals

sub_results.description: the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed remaining line-item subtotals

assertion_tree.verification: Look for the cart-wide total and the displayed remaining line-item subtotals, and confirm they are equal
